summary: Flatter shaded kerb near the bottom end, with homes 20-25 m away.
reasons: Houses about 20-25 m away on this side

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 11-25 m on the south side near 162-168 m; apartments 34 m at the end. Homes close all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street with cars parked along the kerb; room to stop beside parked cars.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, and the signs allow parallel and angle parking, but some stretches are no stopping or no parking.

flags: Slope about 3.5% at the best section; the rest of the kerb is 12-22% (14% mean)
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Toowong Creek 365 m away
Signs show No Stopping and No Parking stretches nearby; check on site
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the best section, mostly from the north and east.
cannot_judge: Which stretch each sign applies to

best_section.where: Bottom (north-west) end of the south kerb, near the corner with the cross street
